verdict.rationale: Braintrust provides both a documented REST API for logs/experiments/datasets and an official MCP server enabling agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) to query logs, run evals, and configure monitoring directly from an editor/terminal, plus 'Loop' agent for natural-language investigation of traces. Evidence is vendor docs only (no independent hands-on confirmation) and no OpenAPI spec was found, slightly limiting confidence.
